title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. translated_title: Mind2Act World：面向机器人操作中具身心智、物理动作与心智-动作组合能力的诊断性基准
translated_abstract: 具身智能旨在让机器人以类人的适应性和可靠性执行复杂的物理任务，这需要三种互补的能力：基于历史信息的认知推理、精确且及时的物理执行，以及通过环境反馈将推理与执行相结合的组合能力。然而，现有基准要么在同一任务中同时评估推理与执行，要么分别评估二者却不测试其组合，因此难以揭示一次失败究竟源自推理、执行还是二者的组合。我们提出了Mind2Act World，这是一个包含来自五个真实世界应用领域的30个仿真操作任务的诊断性基准。每个任务具有三个难度等级和两种场景设置，共产生180种配置。这些任务构成三个视角：Mind测试基于过去观测的决策能力，Act测试精确且及时的执行能力，而Mind2Act则在闭环中将二者相结合。
tldr: Mind2Act World是一个包含180种配置的诊断性基准，通过Mind、Act和Mind2Act三个视角分别评估具身智能体的认知推理、物理执行及二者在闭环中的组合能力，从而精确定位失败源自推理、执行还是其组合。
en_tdlr: Mind2Act World is a diagnostic benchmark with 180 configurations that separately evaluates cognitive reasoning (Mind), precise physical execution (Act), and their closed-loop composition (Mind2Act), enabling precise attribution of failures to reasoning, execution, or their combination.
